title: Murky Markets With No Barriers To Entry
Commodified Intelligence & Expertise
blurb: Classical competitive advantage for a company relied on effort, skill, and intelligence existing as bottlenecks. AI is removing those barriers and eroding where advantage used to exist.
bullet_points: Labor automation — machines executing in highly enumerated or low-specificity spaces. The work itself becomes cheap and outputs lose intrinsic value.
Novel innovation — finding better paths through problems we used to dedicate lifetimes to. New solutions that overnight make pillars of prior human work obsolete.
Simulation-led discovery — iterative design in models and simulations, collapsing physical trial-and-error into evolutionary design at hyper speed, limited only by compute.

title: First Principles Thinking
blurb: Everything we do is rooted in a first-principles understanding, keeping our outcomes refined and deterministic in a world that is becoming more and more bloated and stochastic.

title: Nth° Specificity
